pages.title: A Head on Your Own
pages.text: Right-click to call the head out in front of you, or right-click the head itself with an empty hand to collect it back. It floats along behind you.

Shift and right-click the head to move your view into it. Your body stays where you left it, up to 48 blocks away.$(br2)While looking through the head, you can fly it and interact with blocks.$(br2)$(bold)Coming back$()$(br2)Left-click and the view returns to you at once, and the head flies back to your side on its own.
